lines.t: I've been running through the silence Lost inside my fear again
Every shadow tried to blind me But you called me by my name
The world was loud, I couldn't breathe But in your voice I found my peace
Now I'm breaking through the chains I'm made And I'm not afraid
Every scar, you saw beauty in me Pull me out, say come and be free
Free in your life
I'm not hiding anymore
The weight is gone, I'm yours forevermore No more fear, I'ma fight, I'm alive
Free in your life, oh-oh Free in your life, free in your life, yeah
Used to drown inside my own reflection Tried to fight but I lost direction
Then you reach into my broken heart Turn the ruins into art
Every fall you carried me through Every breath I give back to you
Free in your light I'm not hiding, not hiding anymore
The weight's gone, I'm yours forevermore No more fear, no more fight, I'm alive
Free in your life
Free in your life
Free in your life
You took the night and painted dawn
Your mercy sings where I belong
Even when I'm lost, you guide my way
Hey, hey, Yahushua, you are my escape
Free in your light, I'm not hiding, hiding anymore
The weight is gone, I'm yours forevermore
You broke my chains, gave me life, now I rise
Free in your light
Free in your light
Free your life
Free your life
